Definition: a hole, i.e. hinge or the female pudenda
BiblicalUsage: Poth is a hole, a socket, a hinge, and its two uses could hardly be further apart. In Kings it names the golden hinges of the temple doors, and in Isaiah it names the secret parts the Lord will uncover in judgment on the daughters of Zion.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same word can name a temple hinge and a shame, and the difference is whether a thing is offered to God or hidden from him.
